title: Information Paradox
description: If a black hole evaporates into thermal radiation, whatever fell in is lost, and quantum mechanics forbids that. Something must give. Unlocks the Page Curve Analyzer.

puzzle.goal: A black hole of mass M evaporates completely in a time t that grows as the cube of its mass, from G, ħ and c. Write t.
puzzle.name: Evaporation time
puzzle.ask: Find t in billions of years (u = 3.156e16 s) for M = @{M} kg (G = 6.674e-11, h = 1.0546e-34 for ħ, c = 2.998e8).
puzzle.method: Power radiated goes as 1/M² (Stefan-Boltzmann at T ∝ 1/M over an area ∝ M²); dM/dt ∝ −1/M² integrates to t ∝ M³.
